question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Select the symbol that will be on the face opposite to the one having '@'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61926d906a1fa0c75e01b014389d7f4152fcc6606ad3cc9782d2d024bb9e75e9.png]
solution:
For find the opposite surface of '@', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

Now, symbol '@' is given in Dice 2 and Dice 3, 

So, From Dice 2 and Dice 3,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/773208c3e0fdd46ad5f704494df925e2a7885a852a610f502507971e054b2da4.png] 

→ @ is the common surface and &, #, ©, % is the adjacent surface.

So, the remaining 'O' will be the opposite face of '@'.

Hence, the correct answer is "O".
